messages:
jess: quick sync — we need a final decision on how cache savings appear in the cost dashboard. do we attribute cache credits to the route that caused the cache hit, or to the tenant that owns the response (or split somehow)?

naveen: leaning toward route-first for visibility. ops teams care which API surface is cheaper. tenants can always aggregate.

marco: +1 route-first but with a per-tenant fallback for multi-tenant shared cache. otherwise billing edge cases will be confusing.

sara: from product POV customers expect to see 'how much did route X save me' — route-level credits are better UX. but for billing we still need a tenant rollup.

anya: data note: current telemetry only emits cache_hits and token_counts. we need prefix_token_len and model_variant to do fair apportionment across multi-model requests.

jess: actionable: (1) decide allocation heuristic, (2) add telemetry fields, (3) expose a cache-credit column in per-route report, (4) rollout to canaries.

marco: proposed heuristic: when a cache hit is attributable to a single route -> full credit to route. when request touches multiple routes/models -> split by inferred token ownership (prefix tokens). formula sketch: 
```
credit_route = sum_over_hits(min(prefix_tokens_route, kv_hits) * token_price)
credit_shared = total_cache_credit - sum(credit_route)
if shared: apportion by route_token_fraction or tenant_weight
```

naveen: question: how do we treat function-calls or system tokens? they often inflate prefix_tokens but aren't billable to customer. we need to exclude system tokens from apportionment.

anya: we can add a telemetry flag token_role = {user, assistant, system, function}. should be cheap in logs. then ignore system/function when computing route fractions.

jess: +1. also add model_variant and request_id to traces so we can repro sample traces for audits.

marco: on unit economics: cache savings should be shown as separate negative line item in per-token cost, not mutated into token price. keeps UI clearer.

sara: UI suggestion: show 3 toggles — route view, tenant rollup, and 'shared-credit' toggle (split vs route-only). default to route-only for self-serve.

naveen: billing concerns: for reserved capacity customers we shouldn't reduce invoiceable usage below committed minimums. cache credits are an internal metric for cost optimization, not invoice adjustments unless agreed. note that in UI.

jess: noted. add notice in dashboard and an admin-only toggle to apply credits to invoice mocks.

anya: sampling plan: we'll sample 0.1% of requests with full token-level attribution for 48h to validate heuristics. need a flag in the agent to turn on extra telemetry.

marco: also want a small eval harness to replay sampled traces and compute ground-truth savings. will wire up short script.

jess: small code snippet for how the backend will compute per-route credit in batch job: 
```sql
-- pseudocode for daily rollup
SELECT route, SUM(GREATEST(0, LEAST(prefix_tokens, kv_hits)) * token_price) AS cache_credit
FROM traces WHERE sampled = false -- uses full telemetry
GROUP BY route;
```

naveen: edge case: multi-tenant shared models (public models) — need a conservative cap per-tenant to avoid negative credits. suggest floor = 0 and per-tenant cap = min(tenant_usage, credit).

sara: rollout plan for UX: canary to internal orgs, then opt-in beta for 5 customers, then GA. include a changelog note.

jess: owners: telemetry: anya, backend calc + API: naveen, attribution logic + eval: marco, UI: sara.

anya: I'll add telemetry PR checklist: emit token_role, prefix_tokens, kv_hits, model_variant, request_id.

ops-bot: deployment scheduled: telemetry/flagging agent -> canary (deploy/1913457001), expected rollout window 10m.

jess: thanks — I'll draft an RFC with the heuristic and example calculations. sending to #eng-arch for review after lunch.

marco: sample numbers for RFC (for sanity): route A: 1.2M tokens, cache_saved: 300k tokens -> $X saved; will include in doc.

naveen: +1 on RFC. also need to add docs for audit path so finance can validate credits for enterprise deals.

sara: cool. I'll mock the dashboard card today and post screenshots.

jess: ok wrapping up — next step: RFC + telemetry PR. (:thumbsup:).
